title: statusline r2 AIE: multi-repo aggregate refresh cost undenominated
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lens: ai-engineer (validator: platform-engineer). Owner: SO session. Defect: per-repo budget and display-line bound exist, but N configured repos = N invocations per refresh event and the aggregate wall-clock is neither declared in native units nor checked — the cost the operator actually feels. Citations verified: contract:160, :185. Proposed: deferred to phase-1c (numbers and wiring-script shape; aggregate = N x per-repo budget, N explicit in the same config). Failure: many-repo adopters incur unbudgeted, unqueryable aggregate latency.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Routed at operator triage: deferred to 'phase-1c work item: statusline wiring script shape' (L37 at creation), scope item 4 — aggregate multi-repo refresh cost in native units, N x per-repo budget.
